evidence.snippet:
Point your MCP client at
https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp
and add the API key as a bearer token in the client config
Install the official Firecrawl MCP server and Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Windsurf can call Search, Scrape, Parse

decisions.reason: Firecrawl's own docs explicitly give the hosted MCP endpoint URL and the marketing pages confirm it is an official, vendor-run MCP server.
